**In one line:** Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady as Wall Street reels from Alphabet’s disappointing earnings miss.

## 🚨 Top 5 things to know
🌅 **What happened while you were sleeping:**
- ⚖️ ✅ **Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady at 3.75%–4.00%**
  *What happened:* The US Federal Reserve voted 10-2 to leave interest rates unchanged, though two policymakers preferred a 25 basis point hike [S276, S580]. *Why it matters:* Wall Street had widely anticipated the rate pause, keeping US mortgage rates elevated and putting continued pressure on emerging market currencies [S2, S276]. [S2, S276, S580]

## ✅ What actually matters today
- ⚖️ ✅ **Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady at 3.75%–4.00%**
  *What happened:* The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted 10-2 to keep benchmark interest rates at 3.75%–4.00%, citing sticky inflation [S276, S580]. *Why it happened:* Persistent inflation data convinced most governors that looser monetary policy remains premature [[The Hindu]](https://www.thehindu.com/business/Economy/federal-reserve-likely-to-skip-rate-hike-despite-elevated-inflation/article71634402.ece). *Why it matters:* Borrowing costs remain high, impacting home loans, auto loans, and consumer credit [[breezejmu.org]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxNTC12NXg1Z0RVRWZabTFkejlmYVJtMF9BbEo1c2JMajdscF9oM1RFa3ZPdXlneDBxa2c4U0w5Vm1NeU9uMEcwZVJHVVMtN1JsaktJVTljRUd4ZFpGMlprNVlfbm9iQXd0N1k2bF96REhsYzBZcjFPU19pRWJlaTg4OGFaWTlEU0ZmV20xTGVmYjJzSE5XWlBLVnBzQzFOSEZQcE5lQTFKNEJMYVBmVWw4OXZvNzluZ1R6RjdKd2ctSFR4WmRJX0l1X211WXpyQQ?oc=5). *Who is affected:* Borrowers, mortgage seekers, and emerging market economies [[Investing.com]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOc3hWWFF3bXE3RWdIX3ZleWQ3UjdRTnlPU1E5bWsyeTZ2R1lJMzV2eE1uMDczM1JON1l5OHY5T0tlNms4d0k3M2pmbUFSMVd5cUhvN2k0SHJTbDE3ZWttR0ZJQ1NiVExXakRVaXR6Wjhsd0FENjhQM1pYRWlFUmR3OGd5VWExZGEtNi14eXk3VQ?oc=5). *What happens next:* Markets will monitor upcoming employment and inflation prints for clues on December rate decisions.

  *What happened:* Alphabet missed Wall Street expectations as core search revenue disappointed [[CNBC]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/alphabet-google-search-ai-earnings.html). *Why it happened:* Weaker-than-expected revenue out of the core business impacted profit expectations. *Why it matters:* Investors are questioning whether massive capital expenditures on AI data centers will yield immediate returns [[Yahoo Finance]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOSHFrQlZMOWZ1cW96WjF6VHJLWkI0c0dPcmJweHlhU0swOFh5aW9tMDVEM1BpUzNnQndUVEs3cXpsa2hUX0FPMTFIa0pZc3pFWlJBMzRhbFNLTkhrZThfTTVVVzhUTWNyZm9PMkVvOWdGSDNaQkJZbjB1clJiT1RaamRTUGVMX0ptN3ZwUFEtb3lyQVk?oc=5). *Who is affected:* Global tech investors and software developers. *What happens next:* Tech giants will face intense scrutiny over their capital allocation plans in upcoming quarters.
- ⚖️ 🔵 **PROPOSAL** — **Trump Administration Moves to End H-1B Visa Deference**
  *What happened:* Reports indicate the administration is moving to eliminate prior approval deference for H-1B visa renewals [[Times of India]](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/trump-moves-to-end-h-1b-visa-deference-what-it-means-for-indians-stuck-in-the-green-card-backlog/articleshow/135302881.cms). *Why it happened:* Part of a broader executive push to evaluate domestic labor displacement and tighten skilled immigration compliance [[CBIA]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE9taG8wbGVyaTZyQ0xfUThUejM4bWJpMDZ6ZEVnTWU0YmtITkVQaGFKeHpkRVhzRFQxOW9oNEtDVnBILTFmc3VRdTd5RUpTVTBYLXk4SnpmZlFvTnJVdm5Kd3Ixc1Ziemo1Wl9fUg?oc=5). *Why it matters:* Renewal applications will face de novo reviews, increasing the risk of administrative processing delays or rejections for Indian nationals. *Who is affected:* Indian H-1B visa holders in the US and IT services companies. *What happens next:* Formal administrative steps are being monitored by industry representatives.

  *What happened:* Jio Platforms retained its massive valuation surge following its public debut on Indian exchanges [S197, S203]. *Why it happened:* Overwhelming retail and institutional demand drove heavy post-listing buying [[The Edge Malaysia]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTFAtOVBmZmN2R0s5ZzFZc2x3RmFzU2EwQi1CZzVSN0tvdmRjUkZ0bDRONUFyWTQ0cS1hNXlRN0U4cFZLcm5uSkJ4ZmZ4dUJNMk9q?oc=5). *Why it matters:* It cements Reliance's digital arm as a dominant financial titan [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Who is affected:* Indian equity investors and mutual fund portfolios holding telecom exposure. *What happens next:* Upcoming IPOs will look to price their offerings against Jio's market benchmark [[Business Standard]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 🎓 Today's lesson
**What is a Floating Rate Bond (FRB)?**
When a government borrows money by issuing bonds, standard bonds pay a fixed interest rate (coupon) regardless of market conditions. A Floating Rate Bond (FRB), however, has an interest rate that moves up and down over time. The payout is tied to a benchmark. For example, if the Reserve Bank of India sets an FRB coupon at 7.26% for the upcoming half-year based on prevailing market rates, investors receive payments adjusted to current economic conditions [[RBI (official)]](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63883). This protects investors from inflation eroding fixed returns, while allowing governments flexibility as interest rates fluctuate.
